title: Polysomnography Technologist II
description: Provides technology expertise in sleep studies and performs sleep procedures to aid in the comprehensive evaluation and treatment of sleep disorders. Duties: 1. Performs sleep studies including overnight sleep study, MSLT, CPAP, and BiPAP titrations. • 2. Prepare patient for sleep studies, including admission, education, setup all electrodes, and discharge after completing polysomnography assessment • 3. Reviews medical history, clinical information, medications, and analyses patient information including procedure request and verifies documentation. • 4. Applies electrodes and sensors with appropriate post calibrations to ensure that the signals are artifacts free. • 5. Performs troubleshooting as necessary for acquiring good quality sleep data. • 6. Documents all routine observations including sleep stages, respiratory events, and other significant clinical events. • 7. Implements appropriate interventions necessary for patient's safety during the study. • 8. Demonstrates the knowledge and skills necessary to recognize and provide age specific assessment and care according to policy. Maintains current BLS certification. • 9. Operates and maintains equipment and accessories. Maintains all stock and supplies needed to perform procedures in the sleep laboratory. • 10. Participates in performance improvement activities as assigned. • 11. Assists with scoring sleep/wake stages and clinical events such as respiratory events, periodic limb movements, arousals etc. by using accepted professional guidelines. • 12. Demonstrates effective written and spoken communication skills. Demonstrates ability to follow directions. Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Respiratory Care is required. Experience: Grade 08: • Two (2) years of related experience is required. • Grade 09: • Four (4) years as Polysomnography Technologist II at KFSH&RC, or (Grade 08) related experience is required. • Average of annual performance appraisal at least (3.5) for the last four (4) years. • Fifty (50) hours of cumulative continued medical education [CME]. Other requirements: Current Registration from country of origin and Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCHS) is required. • Successful completion of Polysomnography program with documented proficiency. • Certificate of Basic Life Support (BLS) is required.

title: Staff Nurse I
description: Responsible for providing comprehensive nursing care utilizing the nursing process and meeting the established standard of nursing practice and performance. Demonstrates leadership competencies while in charge or acting as shift resource/team leader. Duties: 1. Provides total patient care as assigned according to the core standards of patient care and established policies and evidence-based practices. • 2. Assumes accountability for assessing, planning, implementing and evaluating care as well as discharge planning for each patient. • 3. Contributes to decreasing the length of stay/waiting time as per unit specific goal. Works in collaboration with Case Management to achieve goals. • 4. Documents all relevant information correctly, appropriately, and in a timely manner. • 5. Reports equipment failures, safety and security issues, and/or reduction of supply inventory to Head Nurse or designee. • 6. Demonstrates collaborative multi-disciplinary partnerships working towards the achievements of constant improvement in quality patient care. Acts as an advocate for patients and families. Identifies ideas that will improve the quality of patient care and issues that will negatively affect patient care outcomes, using the professional practice framework. • 7. Promotes a safe environment and safe patient care by embracing a safety culture and identifying areas of risk to head nurse or designee. Complies with policies for personal and patient safety and for the prevention of healthcare associated infections. • 8. Contributes to the achievement of cost efficiency savings on unit. Maintains an awareness of resource utilization, exercising care in the ordering and use of staff, equipment, and materials. • 9. Contributes to the achievement of clinical quality outcome indicators and patient satisfaction. Leads unit based Performance Improvement activities as assigned. • 10. Participates in new staff/nursing student orientation aimed at developing competence and performance. Assists in maintaining a suitable learning environment and acts as a preceptor/mentor in the supervision and teaching of nursing students and new staff to develop their competence. • 11. Demonstrates transcultural principles in nursing practice. • 12. Contributes to special projects/assignments linked to nursing strategic priorities and professional practice model as assigned. • 13. Assists in promoting and sharing knowledge via mentorship in line with relevant research and evidence based practice. • 14. Follows all Hospital related policies and procedures. • 15. Participates in self and other’s education, training and development, as applicable. Education: Bachelor's or Associate Degree/Diploma in Nursing is required. Experience: Two (2) years of Nursing experience with Bachelor’s or four (4) years with Associate Degree/Diploma is required. • No experience is required for Saudis with Bachelor’s Degree. Enrolment in New Graduate Development Program for staff with less than one (1) year of experience is required. Other requirements: Current Registered Nurse Licensure from country of origin and Saudi Commission for Health Specialties Licensure is required.

title: Neurophysiology Technologist
description: Responsible for a specified procedural area to perform Clinical Neurophysiology Procedures. Duties: 1. Works independently and ensures a proper environment for testing in the laboratory, wards, Emergency Room (ER), or Intensive Care Units (ICUs). • 2. Obtains medical history of patient and summarizes relevant data. Puts patient at ease and explains procedure. Safely performs auditory, visual or electrical stimulation of the nervous system. Adjusts settings of equipment to ensure proper and accurate test results. Recognizes and eliminates artefacts to produce meaningful diagnostic information. • 3. Measures and applies multiple electrodes precisely, carefully, and securely to predetermined anatomic sites. Based on patient’s age, diagnosis, current state and medical history, performs Digital Video Electroencephalography (EEG), Visual, Brainstem Auditory and Somatosensory Evoked Potentials, Nerve conduction Studies, Sleep studies, Pulse Oximetry, Autonomic Studies and Long Term Video/Digital Encephalographic monitoring (LTM), in both adult and paediatric patients. • 4. Performs urgent diagnostic tests on critically ill patients in ICUs and the ER on mobile equipment or in the laboratory setting in coordination with nursing and respiratory therapy personnel. • 5. Monitors patients with surgically implanted intracranial electrodes. • 6. Assists physicians with invasive procedures in Intraoperative Neurophysiological Monitoring, Electrocorticography and Electromyography. • 7. Monitors patients intraoperatively. Performs complex pre-operative setups with electrodes on multiple anatomic sites. Watches and assesses the quality of the neurophysiologic waveforms. Follows the patient’s systemic and anaesthetic state while keeping track of surgical activities. Communicates with and gives feedback to Neurophysiologist as necessary. • 8. Observes patient reactions clinically and electrographically during testing. Notes signs of distress, medical emergencies, or seizures. Takes remedial action, notifies nurse and physician, if necessary. • 9. Makes preliminary analysis and description of the waveforms or potentials, ensuring that it is meaningful and acceptable. Notes pertinent data for physician review. • 10. Ensures safety of patient and safe operation of equipment. Informs supervisor in writing of equipment faults. Maintains work area. Ensures adequate levels of stocks and supplies in procedure areas. • 11. Cleans and disinfects clinical equipment. • 12. Participates in on-call rota for EEG and LTM services. • 13. Works as team leader in procedural areas, on a rotational basis as assigned. • 14. Participates in laboratory quality improvement programs. • 15. Participates in self and others’ education, training and development. • 16. Follows all Hospital policies and procedures. • 17. Performs other related duties as assigned. Education: Bachelor’s , or Associate Degree/Diploma in Clinical Neurophysiology or successful completion of a formal two-year program in Clinical Neurophysiology or other related discipline is required. Experience: Grade 08:Two (2) years of related experience with Bachelor’s or four (4) years with Associate Degree/Diploma or program is required. • Grade 09:Four (4) years of experience as a Neurophysiology Technologist at KFSH&RC,or (Grade 08), related experience is required. • Average of annual performance appraisal at least (3.5) for the last four (4) years. • Fifty (50) cumulative continued medical education (CME) Other requirements: Current Registration from country of origin and Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCHS) is required. • Board registration in EEG/Electro diagnostics or equivalent is required. • Certification through examination from an accredited Electroneurodiagnostic Program.

title: Neurophysiology Technologist
description: Responsible for a specified procedural area to perform Clinical Neurophysiology Procedures. Duties: 1. Works independently and ensures a proper environment for testing in the laboratory, wards, Emergency Room (ER), or Intensive Care Units (ICUs). • 2. Obtains medical history of patient and summarizes relevant data. Puts patient at ease and explains procedure. Safely performs auditory, visual or electrical stimulation of the nervous system. Adjusts settings of equipment to ensure proper and accurate test results. Recognizes and eliminates artefacts to produce meaningful diagnostic information. • 3. Measures and applies multiple electrodes precisely, carefully, and securely to predetermined anatomic sites. Based on patient’s age, diagnosis, current state and medical history, performs Digital Video Electroencephalography (EEG), Visual, Brainstem Auditory and Somatosensory Evoked Potentials, Nerve conduction Studies, Sleep studies, Pulse Oximetry, Autonomic Studies and Long Term Video/Digital Encephalographic monitoring (LTM), in both adult and paediatric patients. • 4. Performs urgent diagnostic tests on critically ill patients in ICUs and the ER on mobile equipment or in the laboratory setting in coordination with nursing and respiratory therapy personnel. • 5. Monitors patients with surgically implanted intracranial electrodes. • 6. Assists physicians with invasive procedures in Intraoperative Neurophysiological Monitoring, Electrocorticography and Electromyography. • 7. Monitors patients intraoperatively. Performs complex pre-operative setups with electrodes on multiple anatomic sites. Watches and assesses the quality of the neurophysiologic waveforms. Follows the patient’s systemic and anaesthetic state while keeping track of surgical activities. Communicates with and gives feedback to Neurophysiologist as necessary. • 8. Observes patient reactions clinically and electrographically during testing. Notes signs of distress, medical emergencies, or seizures. Takes remedial action, notifies nurse and physician, if necessary. • 9. Makes preliminary analysis and description of the waveforms or potentials, ensuring that it is meaningful and acceptable. Notes pertinent data for physician review. • 10. Ensures safety of patient and safe operation of equipment. Informs supervisor in writing of equipment faults. Maintains work area. Ensures adequate levels of stocks and supplies in procedure areas. • 11. Cleans and disinfects clinical equipment. • 12. Participates in on-call rota for EEG and LTM services. • 13. Works as team leader in procedural areas, on a rotational basis as assigned. • 14. Participates in laboratory quality improvement programs. • 15. Participates in self and others’ education, training and development. • 16. Follows all Hospital policies and procedures. • 17. Performs other related duties as assigned. Education: Bachelor’s , or Associate Degree/Diploma in Clinical Neurophysiology or successful completion of a formal two-year program in Clinical Neurophysiology or other related discipline is required. Experience: Grade 08:Two (2) years of related experience with Bachelor’s or four (4) years with Associate Degree/Diploma or program is required. • Grade 09:Four (4) years of experience as a Neurophysiology Technologist at KFSH&RC,or (Grade 08), related experience is required. • Average of annual performance appraisal at least (3.5) for the last four (4) years. • Fifty (50) cumulative continued medical education (CME) Other requirements: Current Registration from country of origin and Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCHS) is required. • Board registration in EEG/Electro diagnostics or equivalent is required. • Certification through examination from an accredited Electroneurodiagnostic Program.
